note: One line under each Punjab chapter's name, written by reading the chapter, where the line built from the book's contents page was empty, a bare author's name, a theme label or garbled. scripts/build-punjab-catalogue.mjs prefers these to the line it builds; scripts/load-blurbs.mjs puts them in the database.

blurbs.eng-pj-9-1: A text on the Prophet ﷺ as the saviour of mankind, used to find a main idea, discuss and argue, study parts of speech and plan informative writing.
